definitions.explanation: Goods or items that have been brought in from overseas. Carries a somewhat old-fashioned connotation of exotic or high-quality Western imports, reflecting historical attitudes toward foreign products.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{舶来|はくらい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧だ。
⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{舶来|はくらい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ウイスキー→ウイスキー：00412_uisukii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にして⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather treasured his imported whiskey.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明治時代|めいじじだい}→明治時代：28080_meijijidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{舶来品|はくらいひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高級品|こうきゅうひん}→高級品：21439_koukyuuhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{象徴|しょうちょう}→象徴：05534_shouchou⟧だった。
examples.english: In the Meiji era, imported goods were a symbol of luxury.

notes:
Literally "arriving by ship" ({舶|はく} = ocean vessel, {来|らい} = coming), reflecting a time when foreign goods arrived by sea.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {舶来品|はくらいひん} (imported goods)
- {舶来|はくらい}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (imported items)
- {舶来|はくらい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{洋酒|ようしゅ}→洋酒：27829_youshu⟧ (imported Western liquor)

This word has a distinctly nostalgic or old-fashioned flavor. It was especially common in the Meiji through early Showa periods, when Western imports were rare and prestigious. In modern Japanese, ⟦{輸入|ゆにゅう}→輸入：01742_yunyuu⟧ (import) is the standard neutral term. {舶来|はくらい} is now mainly used to evoke a sense of vintage luxury or in historical contexts.
